description: Remove a collection from the workspace registry, leaving every file on disk untouched. list_collections reads that registry, so this is how an entry stops being listed, including a stale entry whose directory is gone. To delete the collection itself, use delete_collection.

collectionPath.description: Absolute path of the collection as it is listed. Use the path from list_collections: matching is by path, not by name, because two entries are allowed to share a name.

workspacePath.description: Absolute path of the workspace.yml to remove the entry from. Defaults to the same one list_collections reads: BRUNO_WORKSPACE_PATH, or the Bruno app's workspace for this platform.

name: unregister_collection
title: Unregister Collection
